bookkeeping_differences.explanation: The ISO baseline contains the optical package repository entry; replay used a separate explicit repository list. Image builds use explicit pinned caches.

The sole byte difference is the abuild package record for var/cache/distfiles: group 300 in the baseline versus group 0 in replay. The signed archive names the abuild group with numeric fallback 0; the signed base-layout package defines group 300. Installation order differs. Exact group-resolution timing is inferred because its diagnostic was unavailable. Neither database was normalized or modified.
The baseline retains an empty mode-0600 APK lock file; replay leaves no lock file. Both states were observed without modification.
